note: Reference library of the Fucheng campus twin. Every source is tied to the twin data it informs; photographs stay where they already are in the repository and are cited by path and git blob id. Capture dates are unknown unless stated. Photo-derived numbers are estimates with the stated uncertainty, never survey data.

credibility_tags.surveyed: measured on site (none yet in phase 1)
credibility_tags.documented: stated in a published text or inscription
credibility_tags.photo-derived: measured or read on a photograph (calibrated where noted)
credibility_tags.estimated: inferred from indirect evidence (risers, proportions, orthophoto reading)
credibility_tags.invented: artistic completion where no evidence exists
